newsitem.title: USA: N. Carolina Senate approves $11.4 billion budget.
newsitem.headline: N. Carolina Senate approves $11.4 billion budget.

text.p: The North Carolina Senate has approved an $11.4 billion budget bill that raises spending by eight percent over this year.
The proposal passed 30-18 late Wednesday and now goes to the House, a Senate clerk said.

The budget raises state agency spending by $850 million, including $50 million for environmental programs and $500 million for public schools. The increase puts total public school spending at about $5 billion.
The plan gives pay raises of 6.5 percent to teachers and three percent to other state employees.
It uses $23 million of federal funds to help pay for expansion of the Smart Start early childhood education program to 12 more counties.
